name: Hong Kong Mong Kok Visual Exposure Study

summary.task: Assess a high-density Hong Kong urban route using real OSM buildings and sensitive public areas.
summary.notice: Estimated visual exposure is computed from OpenStreetMap footprints, inferred building heights, and planned camera settings.

zh.name: 香港旺角视觉暴露研究
zh.task: 使用真实 OSM 建筑和敏感公共区域，评估香港高密度城区中的无人机航线。
zh.notice: 估计视觉暴露基于 OpenStreetMap 建筑轮廓、推断建筑高度和计划相机设置计算。
